answer_2.quote: We report the micro F1 scores, a standard evaluation metric for RE, achieved by each method on the benchmark datasets ... The omission of logical rules causes more significant performance degradation, with the F1 score dropping by 11.5. ... The average accuracy of pseudo labels on the TACREV is 85%...

answer_4.quote: We manually judge two criteria: 1) Whether the premise is consistent with the context in the origin sentence (Context). 2) Whether the premise should be mapped to the ground-truth label (Relation).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators manually evaluated each rule premise according to the two criteria (Context consistency and Relation consistency).
